source: Label definitions by Omar Shalaby (omar/classifier/defs_v1.json on origin/omar/gezira-harness). Routes follow his tiers: identifiers protect, health and criminal data local, forbidden requests refuse.

PERSON.definition: the name of a natural person (not a company)

CONTACT.definition: an email address, phone number or home address of a person

IBAN.definition: an IBAN or bank account number

BSN.definition: a Dutch citizen service number (BSN) or another national ID / passport number

POLICY_ID.definition: an insurance policy number, claim number or customer number

HEALTH.definition: any information about the physical or mental health of a specific person, also indirect

THIRD_PARTY_HEALTH.definition: health information about someone other than the policyholder (family member, passenger, other party)

MENTAL_HEALTH.definition: information about the mental health of a specific person

WORK_INCAPACITY.definition: a specific person being on sick leave, unable to work, or in reintegration

CRIMINAL.definition: criminal offences, suspicions, arrests, convictions or a criminal record of a specific person

AUTO_DECISION.definition: a request that the AI itself takes or sends a final decision with legal effect on a person (reject/settle/cancel/flag fraud/set premium) without a human reviewing it first; drafts or recommendations for a human handler do NOT count

DISCRIMINATORY.definition: a request to select, rank, price or target people by ethnicity, nationality, name origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, health or disability (or a proxy for these)

BULK_EXPORT.definition: a request to list, extract or export personal or sensitive data of many people at once

INJECTION.definition: embedded instructions aimed at an AI system that try to override rules, disable anonymisation, change its role or send raw data somewhere
